SITE QUIRKS OBSERVED
----------------------------------------
- 2012 'Full Meet Results' link points to a JPG photo (https://allcityswimdive.org/_uploads/allcitymeets/2012/CIMG2850.jpg), not a text results document — noted, not extracted.
- 2015 '15-19 Boys' link on the swim-2015 page actually points to the 2014 results file (https://allcityswimdive.org/_upload/allcitymeets/2014/allcity2014_15-19_boys.pdf) instead of a 2015-specific file. This appears to be a mislabeled/duplicated link on the source site itself (same quirk pattern as seen in the 1970s archive). The text for this entry above is therefore the 2014 15-19 Boys results, not distinct 2015 results.
